rationale: The agent verified the user via email before accessing account data, then correctly identified the order containing the fleece jacket and noted it was pending, so not eligible for exchange. The agent offered appropriate alternatives (modify or cancel), explicitly confirmed the scope (entire order) and reason before performing the cancellation, executed the cancellation via the tool, and confirmed the result accurately. The refund statement aligns with the tool’s refund record and typical timelines. When asked to place a new order (not supported by tools), the agent properly declined to place it, instead providing available product options using the product tool. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims were made.
